why:
`get_result` with the deserialisation buffer's capacity supplied as a template parameter instead of taken from `A::Result::SERIALIZED_SIZE_MAX`. Ours-only because it exists to bound a stack array: rclcpp_action allocates. The same `_sized` suffix appears across the C++ surface wherever a caller must be able to say how much stack it is willing to spend.

phase-428 (RFC-0089): re-keyed by the namespace flip. `nros::ActionClient<A>` / `nros::ActionServer<A>` are now aliases of `rclcpp_action::Client<A>` / `rclcpp_action::Server<A>`, which the extractor keys as `Client::*` / `Server::*`. The type is `same` now and the member is `ours-only`, so it no longer inherits its type's verdict and carries its own.
